name: Slotify
tagline: Inserts a sponsor read into a podcast at the best moment, in a matching voice, in one click.
problem: Manual ad insertion in podcasts is slow and risks breaking the listener's flow.
solution: Finds the top three insertion points from pauses, topic shifts and pacing, generates a voice-consistent sponsor read, lets the creator preview each slot and exports the blended episode.
demo_moment: Team-described: preview three seconds before, the ad, and three seconds after for each slot.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of ElevenLabs” among 160 submissions.
Turns a tedious creator chore into one click.

lessons: A narrow, money-adjacent creator workflow is a strong voice-AI demo.
